exam: TNPSC Group II / IIA · General Studies and Aptitude
scope: General Studies and Aptitude Q101–200, common to both language booklets, presented in English. Each question links to its printed page. Q101 was referred to an expert committee.

questionCandidates.text:
Which geological period and epoch does the booklet associate with the origin of modern humans?
(i) Tertiary – Paleocene
(ii) Tertiary – Pliocene
(iii) Tertiary – Oligocene
(iv) Tertiary – Miocene
issues: TNPSC referred this question and its answer to an expert committee.

questionCandidates.text: Match compounds (a) chloroform, (b) phosgene, (c) tear gas, (d) mustard gas to 1 CCl₃NO₂, 2 ClC₂H₄–S–C₂H₄Cl, 3 CHCl₃, 4 COCl₂.
issues: Tear gas is a broad category; the particular compound in the question is chloropicrin.

questionCandidates.text: Assess claims about carbon monoxide pollution: 1 incomplete combustion is its main cause; 2 petrol engines are especially associated with it; 3 prolonged exposure can cause nausea.

Under the historical racial classification used in the exam, assess claims about the so-called Nordics: 1 Indo-Aryans were the final immigrant group; 2 they immediately followed the Negritos; 3 arrival was dated to 2000–1500 BCE.
issues: Historical racial typologies are outdated and are not valid modern biological classifications. This records the exam's framework, not an endorsement.

questionCandidates.text: Assess statements on the Malwa Plateau: 1 average height 600 m and eastward slope; 2 mainly drained by the Chambal system; 3 extends across Rajasthan, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.

Assess statements about Satakarni: 1 first Satavahana king but not powerful; 2 achievements absent from the inscription named Managhat in the paper; 3 his name appears at a Sanchi gateway and he is associated with the title Lord of Dakshinapatha.
issues: Printed 'Managhat' likely refers to Naneghat; historical inscription/title attribution requires independent review.

questionCandidates.text: Assertion: Gopal Krishna Gokhale combined political leadership with social reform. Reason: He helped establish the Servants of India Society.
Order these events from earliest to latest: 1 Communal Award; 2 Gandhi–Irwin Pact; 3 Chittagong uprising; 4 Poona Pact.
Assess Congress-related claims: 1 A. O. Hume is regarded as its founding father; 2 S. N. Banerjee was its inaugural president; 3 Banerjee founded the Indian National Liberation Federation.
Select accurate place–region associations: 1 Bodh Gaya–Baghelkhand; 2 Khajuraho–Bundelkhand; 3 Shirdi–Vidarbha; 4 Nashik–Malwa; 5 Tirupati–Rayalaseema.
Which amendment inserted Fundamental Duties into India's Constitution?
issues: Existing secondary GS index 5 corresponds to printed Q111.

questionCandidates.text: Identify the inaccurate proposition about India's President, as of the examination date.

options.A: The President may resign at any time
options.B: The President cannot continue beyond five years
options.D: No Indian President had been impeached

questionCandidates.text: Assess the chapter associations in the Tamil Nadu Panchayats Act, 1994: 1 Chapter II – Gram Sabha; 2 Chapter VII – taxation and finance; 3 Chapter XII – penalties.
Match constitutional provisions (a) 280, (b) 263, (c) 262, (d) 279A to institutions or subjects: 1 Inter-State Council; 2 inter-state water disputes; 3 GST Council; 4 Finance Commission.
Which establishment-year associations are inaccurate? 1 NHRC—1993; 2 Central Information Commission—2005; 3 Central Vigilance Commission—1963; 4 Central Bureau of Investigation—1969.

Pair the listed consumer-policy milestones (a) Tamil Nadu Consumer Protection Act, (b) consumer movement, (c) Tamil Nadu Consumer Protection Rules, (d) Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act with 1 1969; 2 1988; 3 1986; 4 1974.
issues: The exam's label for the 1986 consumer protection legislation is retained; the Consumer Protection Act 1986 was central legislation. The consumer movement has no single universally applicable start date.

questionCandidates.text: Whose birth anniversary was commemorated by Tamil Nadu with observances from 29 April through 5 May, according to the 2025 paper?
Arrange the states by their position in the SDG India Index 2023–24: 1 Tamil Nadu; 2 Uttarakhand; 3 Kerala; 4 Goa.
issues: Uttarakhand and Kerala share the highest score in the referenced index; their relative order is not a distinct rank.

questionCandidates.text: Evaluate the proposals in the women's reservation bill passed by Lok Sabha on 20 September 2023: 1 about one-third of Lok Sabha and state assembly seats for women; 2 SC/ST reserved seats excluded; 3 duration of 25 years; 4 commencement after delimitation.

Which reasons are identified in the paper for the Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai scheme? 1 income inequality by gender in the 2023 Global Gender Gap Report; 2 improving women's poor social position; 3 advancement of rural women; 4 acknowledging women's extensive unpaid labour.
issues: The question asks for the specific stated rationale; broader welfare aims may overlap.

questionCandidates.text: Identify accurate expansions: 1 NHS—National Health Service; 2 CBHI—Central Bureau of Health Insurance; 3 PHC—Primary Health Center; 4 NRHM—National Real Health Mission.
Which goals belong to e-NAM? 1 integration of agricultural markets through a national online platform; 2 helping producers obtain better prices; 3 widening farmers' selling opportunities.
Assertion: Living conditions in rural Tamil Nadu have improved. Reason: The state introduced its Tamil Nadu Village Habitations Improvement Scheme.

options.B: Both true and reason explains assertion
options.D: Both true but reason does not explain assertion

issues: The specimen's assertion–reason relationship is recorded, not independent evidence of causal impact.

questionCandidates.text: Select skill-development objectives cited in the exam: 1 women's economic independence; 2 skills training for young people nationwide; 3 monetary incentives linked to certification and employability; 4 higher workforce productivity.
issues: The printed stem names the National Skill Development Council; institutional naming and attribution require review.

questionCandidates.text: Associate (a) Mathi Bazar, (b) Pasumai Veedugal Thittam, (c) Naan Mudalvan, (d) Aajeevika with 1 clean energy; 2 skills; 3 poverty reduction; 4 self-help groups.
At the time of the 2025 exam, what was the individual cashless-care cap under Nammai Kaakum 48 for the initial 48 hours after a road accident?
Where did the Central Institute of Classical Tamil begin operating from its dedicated new campus in 2022?
Assess the exam-era MSME claims about Tamil Nadu: 1 third nationally in Udyam registration; 2 women account for 30% of entrepreneurs; 3 Coimbatore leads the state in MSME numbers.
issues: Historical exam-era figures, not a statement of current registration rankings.

questionCandidates.text: Match Sangam-era references (a) courtship emblem, (b) love emblem, (c) crow as favourable omen, (d) Pandil game with 1 Kuruntogai; 2 Ashoka leaf; 3 Natrinai; 4 white lily.

Evaluate the scholarly attributions about Khalji architecture: 1 K. S. Lal links Alauddin's accession to a new phase of Indo-Islamic architecture; 2 Marshall praises Hauz-i-Khas as a leading jewel of Islamic architecture; 3 Percy Brown emphasizes Alauddin's mosque gateway in India's architectural development.
issues: Attributions paraphrased; consult the source page for quotations.

questionCandidates.text: Identify mismatched historical figures and places: 1 Gopala Nayak—Dindigul; 2 Dhoondaji Wagh—Madurai; 3 Marudhu brothers—Ettayapuram; 4 Pulithevan—Nerkattanseval.
Order from earliest to latest: 1 Civil Disobedience Movement; 2 Sepoy Mutiny; 3 Vellore Mutiny; 4 South Indian Rebellion.
In the interpretation of the Tirukkural used by this question, whose obligations are conveyed indirectly?
issues: Interpretive literary question; specimen choice recorded without claiming a unique interpretation.

questionCandidates.text: Associate the works (a) Thirukkural Uraivalam, (b) Thirukkural Nunporul Malai, (c) Thirukkural Araichi Pathippu, (d) Vazhum Valluvam (வாழும் வள்ளுவம்) with 1 Va. Se. Kulanthai Samy; 2 Ki. Va. Jeganathan; 3 Karirathina Kavirayar; 4 Thandapani Thesigar.
For Valluvar, which quality constitutes true possession?
Place the following Pallava rulers in historical sequence using the reign dates given: 1 Simhavishnu (555–590 CE); 2 Mahendravarman I (590–630); 3 Narasimhavarman I (630–668); 4 Rajasimha (695–728).

Associate these Tamil literary references to the Sangam: (a) தலைச் சங்கப் புலவனார் தம்முள்; (b) அகன் பொதியில் திருமுனிவன் தமிழ்ச் சங்கம்; (c) கூடலினாய்ந்த ஒண்டீந் தமிழ்; (d) மதுரைத் தொகையாக்கினான். Authors: 1 Kambar; 2 Sekkizhar; 3 Thirugnanasambandar; 4 Manikkavasagar.
issues: Classical Tamil phrases retained as reference identifiers; consult scan for precise orthography.

questionCandidates.text: Which Sangam woman poet celebrated battlefield courage in the verse containing 'தோன்றுவன் மாதோ போர்க்களத்தானே'?
A job takes one day for any one of these groups: three men, four women or twelve boys. How long would a team of one man, one woman and five boys take?
A metal sphere, 8 cm in diameter, is recast as a cylindrical wire 3 mm thick (diameter). Determine its length.
An investment grows to ₹13,380 in three years and ₹20,070 in six years under constant compound interest. Calculate the starting principal.
Maths, Physics and Biology seat counts have ratio 5:7:8. They rise by 40%, 50% and 75% respectively. Find the ratio of the resulting totals.
issues: Interprets the printed phrase 'increased seats' as new totals, not just additions.

questionCandidates.text: Three runners start together at the same point on a circular track. Their lap times are 252, 308 and 198 seconds. When are all three next at the starting point?
Sugar costs ₹255 for 15 kg, tea ₹1,615 for 17 kg and rice ₹572 for 22 kg. At these rates find the cost of 18 kg sugar, 21 kg tea and 27 kg rice.
An income rises by 10%, then falls by 10% of the new amount. Calculate the net percentage change.
Continue the sequence: 64, 32, 48, 120, 420, ___
In @18HLI6K*&?UE, count digits with a vowel immediately to their left and a consonant immediately to their right.
In a class of 45, Ravi stands ninth from the top and 18 pupils rank below Raj. How many pupils rank strictly between them?

Nine boxes (red, black, white, green, yellow, blue, orange, violet, pink) form a vertical stack. Red and white have five between them. Yellow sits directly above white; three boxes separate yellow and green. The red–green gap equals the black–yellow gap. Blue lies below black but not at the bottom, with more than four boxes between blue and yellow. One box separates blue and orange. Pink lies above violet. Which colours immediately flank black, above and below respectively?
Using the same coding rule that transforms DANGER into 10-7-20-13-11-24, encode MACHINE.
Interpret → as +, ← as −, ↑ as ÷, ↓ as × and ↗ as =. Which equation is true under standard precedence?

Which roles are attributed to carbon in organisms? 1 structural framework of organic compounds; 2 bonding with other molecules; 3 versatility of biomolecular structures and functions, including DNA and RNA.
Select the incorrect association: 1 Down syndrome—trisomy 21; 2 haemophilia—sex-linked inheritance; 3 Klinefelter syndrome—XO karyotype; 4 Turner syndrome—female with reduced growth.
Which properties suit a material for an electromagnet core? I small hysteresis-loop area; II high permeability; III high coercivity; IV low retentivity.
issues: A narrow hysteresis loop, rather than merely small area, is the wording of the printed property I.

questionCandidates.text: Match goal numbers (a) SDG 6, (b) SDG 11, (c) SDG 14, (d) SDG 15 with 1 terrestrial ecosystems; 2 life below water; 3 clean water and sanitation; 4 sustainable cities and communities.

Evaluate soil statements: 1 Himalayan rivers deposited much of the northern plains' soil; 2 black soil has a comparatively high iron oxide content; 3 soil formed from Deccan Trap rocks is fertile and retains moisture well.
issues: Statement 2 lacks a specified comparator; specimen choice recorded without final-key certification.

questionCandidates.text: Which description of Akbar's Din-i-Ilahi is selected in the historical framework of the specimen?

options.C: An attempt to create a common faith acceptable to Hindus and Muslims
options.D: A policy for territorial expansion and control of independent states

issues: The interpretation of Din-i-Ilahi as a national religion is a textbook characterization and is historically debated.

questionCandidates.text: Which copper-plate record is identified in the exam as evidence of the Chola queen Vanamadevi's sati?
Identify the correct colonial-administration associations: 1 Permanent Settlement—Curzon; 2 Bengal partition—Cornwallis; 3 Ryotwari—Munro; 4 railway expansion—Dalhousie.
Match writers (a) Bharathiar, (b) Kavimani Desiga Vinayagam Pillai, (c) Bharathidasan, (d) Ramalingam Pillai with works 1 Pandian Parisu; 2 Tamilan Ithayam; 3 Kannan Pattu; 4 Asia Jothi.
Order chronologically: 1 INA trials; 2 establishment of INA; 3 Royal Indian Air Force; 4 C. Rajagopalachari formula.
issues: The IAF was founded in 1932; the Royal prefix came later (1945). The specimen's terminology is ambiguous.

questionCandidates.text: Pair (a) judicial activism, (b) Second ARC ethics in governance, (c) Restatement of Values of Judicial Life, (d) administrative tribunals with dates 1 1976; 2 1997; 3 1947; 4 2007.
issues: Judicial activism has no single founding date; 1976 refers to constitutional provision rather than the later tribunal legislation.

questionCandidates.text: Which are fundamental duties? 1 uphold national sovereignty, unity and integrity; 2 protect and enhance the environment; 3 preserve composite cultural heritage; 4 protect private property.
Assertion: India's Constitution specifically names the power of judicial review. Reason: Courts have enlarged the scope of that power over time.

options.D: Both true; R does not explain A

issues: Distinguish express use of the term from constitutional provisions enabling review.

questionCandidates.text: Select the correct descending order of ceremonial precedence for the listed offices.

options.A: Union Ministers of State, Chief Ministers, Lok Sabha Speaker, Vice-President
options.B: Vice-President, Lok Sabha Speaker, Chief Ministers, Union Ministers of State
options.C: Vice-President, Union Ministers of State, Lok Sabha Speaker, Chief Ministers
options.D: Vice-President, Lok Sabha Speaker, Union Ministers of State, Chief Ministers

issues: Precedence of Chief Ministers is qualified by state/jurisdiction in the official table.

questionCandidates.text: Find the mismatched Supreme Court case and subject.

Passage summary: A society needs women's participation to develop. Removing discrimination enables women to contribute to their families and communities. Kofi Annan linked gender equality to poverty reduction, sustainability and accountable governance. Which policy emphasis best reflects this passage?
issues: Passage summarized editorially, not quoted.

questionCandidates.text: Which document contains the medieval guarantee that a person may not be imprisoned, deprived of possessions or exiled except under lawful judgment or the law of the land?
Evaluate NCDC descriptions: 1 statutory corporation; 2 autonomous organization; 3 public financial institution; 4 controlled administratively by the agriculture and farmers' welfare ministry.
issues: Institutional terminology and ministry assignment should be independently reviewed; specimen mark only.

questionCandidates.text: Assertion (exam framing): HIV transmission is often associated with behavioural patterns. Reason: transmission through transfused blood can occur when screening and monitoring are inadequate.

options.C: Both true; R does not explain A

issues: HIV, not AIDS, is transmitted; exposure can be voluntary or involuntary. Avoid attributing blame to people living with HIV. Exam framing is not a medical claim.

questionCandidates.text: Match (a) Ryotwari report, (b) renaming Panchamar schools as Adi Dravidar schools, (c) opposition to patriarchal chauvinism, (d) theory of justice with 1 Periyar; 2 Munro and Ellis; 3 Rawls; 4 Ayothidasar and Singaravelar.

Assertion: Women's hostels, childcare and tailored skill programmes promote women's workforce participation and social justice. Reason: eliminating economic participation barriers builds a more inclusive workforce.

options.D: Both true; R does not explain A

questionCandidates.text: Which benefit is most directly associated with Swachh Bharat's sanitation and solid-waste-management objectives?

options.C: Better public health and cleanliness habits

questionCandidates.text: Which legislation introduced a three-year tax incentive for eligible startups?
issues: The middle choices are dates rather than acts, as in the extracted source.

questionCandidates.text: Find incorrect pairs in the exam's migration terminology: 1 rural→rural: reverse push-back; 2 rural→urban: push–pull; 3 urban→urban: urban turnover; 4 urban→rural: rural turnover.
issues: Terminology follows the specimen's textbook framework.

questionCandidates.text: Which listed energy source is renewable and prominent in Tamil Nadu?
Assertion: Migration involves movement of people across regions or territories. Reason: it can take the form of international or external migration.
Find incorrect city nicknames: 1 Coimbatore – Manchester of South India; 2 Madurai – Tamil Nadu's cultural capital; 3 Namakkal – rice bowl; 4 Thanjavur – egg city.
Identify correct associations of birds and Sangam landscapes: 1 Kurinji – parrot; 2 Mullai – junglefowl; 3 Marudam – lark; 4 Neydal – owl; 5 Palai – pigeon.
Which inscription–ruler associations are correct? 1 Kaverippakkam – Varaguna; 2 Thirumukkudal – Virarajendra; 3 Tiruvalangadu plates – Rajendra I; 4 Uthiramerur – Parantaka I.
Assertion: British forces launched an attack on Sivagangai in 1801. Reason: Chinna Marudhu sheltered Oomaidurai that year.

options.D: Both true; R does not explain A

questionCandidates.text: Which political party organized the Anti-Non-Cooperation League in the Madras Presidency?
Who, according to the exam's literary attribution, called the Tirukkural the sacred book of the Tamils?
issues: Attribution retained provisionally.

questionCandidates.text: Select correct claims about the Tirukkural: 1 Hindi translation attributed to Appathetsithar (as extracted); 2 German translation attributed to Ariel; 3 begins with அ and ends with ன; 4 friendship section has thirteen chapters.
issues: Scan confirms Tamil letter அ in both language versions and the printed translator name Appathetsithar; transliteration not independently standardized.

questionCandidates.text: Order Valluvar's five qualities of சான்றாண்மை as presented in the Kural: 1 modesty (நாணம்); 2 truth (வாய்மை); 3 love (அன்பு); 4 beneficence (ஒப்புரவு); 5 consideration (கண்ணோட்டம்).
Assertion: A traditional encomium presents the Tirukkural as encompassing every subject. Reason: Valluvar introduced many ideas that challenged the prevailing views of his era.

options.D: Both true; R does not explain A

issues: Literary praise is figurative rather than a literal claim of encyclopedic coverage.

questionCandidates.text: Identify the literary device in the classical Tamil phrase ‘இருப்பு முகம் செறித்த ஏந்தெழில் மருப்பின்’.
issues: The exam's English gloss of வேற்றுமை அணி is retained; the Tamil literary classification is more specific than English irony.

questionCandidates.text: Select the accurate district–Sangam coin discovery associations: 1 Dharmapuri–Thoppoor; 2 Salem–Kanniyan Kuttai; 3 Erode–Mukkombu; 4 Tiruchirappalli–Vembavoor.
Workers A, B and C alone need 12, 15 and 20 days respectively to finish a job. All begin together, but C stops after two days. How many additional days will A and B need?
A square garden has a 2 m wide exterior border of area 288 m². Determine the perimeter of the garden itself.
Two simple-interest loans start together: A owes ₹16,000 at 12% annually and B owes ₹12,000 at 18% annually. When will the total amounts owed coincide?
A purchase of twelve tables and chairs costs ₹500. Each table costs ₹50 and each chair ₹40. Determine the ratio of the number of chairs to tables.
issues: The English stem asks for the number ratio, not the price ratio.

questionCandidates.text: For positive integer a, lcm(a, a+2) = 1300. Determine lcm(a, a+1).
Find the two positive integers whose ratio is 15:11 and whose greatest common divisor is 13.
A rectangular surface measures 15 m 17 cm by 9 m 2 cm. Find the fewest identical square tiles needed to cover it exactly without cutting.
issues: English uses ceiling and Tamil uses floor; the dimensions and calculation agree.

questionCandidates.text: Given a/b = 4/5 and b/c = 15/16, evaluate (c²−a²)/(c²+a²).
The integer formed by concatenating 311 seven times is divisible by which of 3 and 11?
Assign A=1, B=2, …, Z=26. Which expression does not equal Aᴮ+Bᶜ+Cᴬ?
On a standard six-faced cube, face 1 is opposite 4 and face 2 is opposite 5. Which statement about adjacent faces is true?
P is older than Q. R is between Q and P in age. S is older than P but younger than T. Identify the youngest person.
